items.title: HDFC Life posts 14% rise in Sept quarter profit
items.description: Value of new business (VNB) margin expanded 20 basis points to 24.7% against 24.5% a year ago. One basis point is a hundredth of a percentage point. Value of new business grew 12% to ₹2,040 crore.

items.title: HDFC Bank Q2 results preview: PAT, NII may rise up to 9% YoY; deposit growth in focus
items.description: HDFC Bank is set to unveil its Q2 results on October 17, 2026, showcasing key financial indicators. Analysts predict a year-on-year rise in net interest income of about 8%, driven by an increase in loans. Profit after tax forecasts vary among brokerages, reflecting a range of expectations regarding the bank's financial health.

items.title: Wipro faces slow recovery as revenue and deal wins lag peers
items.description: Wipro has reported a decline in revenue for the second quarter in a row, contrasting with larger rivals that experienced growth. The total value of new contracts has dropped significantly, indicating delays in project closures. Despite this, management is optimistic about future improvements in deal momentum and operating margins. Slight enhancements were noted in operating margins, attributed to increased efficiency and favorable currency fluctuations.
